scope: Proposition 3.2 (Parity chamber data) of the manuscript “Nonhomeomorphic closed aspherical four-manifolds with the same homotopy type” (preprints/Nonhomeomorphic-closed-aspherical-four-manifolds-with-the-same-homotopy-type-October-4-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 320 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d578110a4422046), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are chamber data (D, P, S, H) satisfying the chamber hypotheses of Theorem 3.1, with H a finitely generated nonabelian free group, and a distinguished epimorphism w: H → Z with the following properties. For d ≥ 1, put Hd = w−1(dZ), let Dd, Pd be the associated connected cyclic covers, and let Sd be the preimage of S. (i) For every d, the boundary Sd is connected, and (Dd, Pd, Sd, Hd) satisfies all the chamber hypotheses of Theorem 3.1, with the full framed immersed hyperbolic basis and its vanishing quadratic self-intersections lifted from D. (ii) There is a compact oriented topological four-manifold V with an orientation-preserving boundary identification ∂V = S2 and a homotopy equivalence j : (V, S2) −→ (P2, S2) equal to the identity on the boundary. (iii) For every odd d ≥ 3, there is no compact oriented topological four-manifold Vd with an orientation-preserving boundary identification ∂Vd = Sd and a homotopy equivalence Vd → Pd whose boundary restriction is homotopic to the inclusion Sd → Pd.
